# Most ABBA song titles identified from the track in one minute
![Most ABBA song titles identified from the track in one minute](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/images/css/gwr-ph.jpg)
**Share**

[ Contact an Account Manager ](https://business.guinnessworldrecords.com/contact-us?source=Website-EN-B2B%20Form) [ Apply Now ](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/account/application/begin/15-464124) Who
    Akarsh Chalasani What
     21 total number  Where
     United Kingdom (London)  When
     30 May 2024 
The most ABBA song titles identified from the track in one minute is 21, and was achieved by Akarsh Chalasani (UK) in London, UK, on 30 May 2024.
Akarsh first came across ABBA when he watched Mamma Mia in 2020. Since then he has listened to all of their albums, and watched the Mamma Mia movies, West End play and the Voyage concert multiple times. 
Records change on a daily basis and are not immediately published online. For a full list of record titles, please use our Record Application Search. (You will need to register / login for access)
